scope: Stored-block ADPCM decoding, Gaussian interpolation and pitch/modulation arithmetic compared with a pinned independent software implementation. All 255 original stored samples have matching PCM hashes and predictor histories. No original hardware, SPU clock, complete voice, audible scene or whole audio group acceptance.

comparison_tool.license: GPL-2.0-or-later; independent private comparison tool only; source not included in MIT port
comparison_tool.provided_inputs: Supplied predictor history and block bytes; IRQ disabled. No device/runtime acceptance.

gaussian_numeric_table_provenance.source_code_reused: Numeric hardware table only; Rust interpolation newly implemented.

limits: Reserved filters and shifts are explicit bounded errors; none occurs in original supplied stored samples.
Stored PCM decoding does not schedule loop/end flags or decoder prefetch.
Transfer, envelopes, noise, sweep, reverb, mixing, music and output integration remain open.
Default Bevy scene still queues audio requests. No hardware recording comparison.
